t: The Architect's Pivot: File-Backed State for Scalable Data Analysis
s: This article details a shift in GAPalyzer's architecture from fragile in-database blob storage to robust file-backed state management for scalable data analysis, driven by debugging a data bloat issue with SQLite.
sub: File-backed state management vs. in-database blob storage
Scalable data analysis and AI-driven applications
Resolving SQLite 'string or blob too big' errors
Competitive and content gap analysis methodology
